change_summary: A correction changes the nerve-block group's mean opioid dose in Table 4 (sensitivity analysis excluding prior opioid users) from 12 mg to 19 mg. The notice says the primary outcome in Table 2 and all other results are unchanged. The stored paper reports 12 mg for that analysis and says it was descriptive and not powered for formal comparison.
evaluation: Your Background and rationale section cites Oyelaran et al. [15] for the 24-hour pain result (3.1 versus 5.2), and the stored paper reports those same figures. The correction changes only the nerve-block group's mean opioid dose in the sensitivity analysis, from 12 mg to 19 mg, and says the primary outcome in Table 2 and all other results are unchanged. So the pain result your draft relies on is not touched, and the impact on your draft is none.
